rule_review: E9.5 is explicitly permitted by current official rules §10. The Data-page external scRNA ambiguity does not establish a prohibition on spatial Stereo-seq. Historical Batch2 blanket-email and shape-only gates do not govern this new route.
attribution: Chen et al. 2022, DOI 10.1016/j.cell.2022.04.003; STOmicsDB accession STDS0000058
post_download_requirements: Inspect stage/genotype and source annotation before numerical analysis
Determine whether expression/coordinates and preprocessing use E9.5 alone; do not reuse cross-stage embeddings, regulons or inferred future labels
Create a separate explicit T2 training permit only after these checks
Keep out of E9.5 pseudo-holdout training; admit only to final fit if eligible
forbidden_downloads: Derived mixed-stage embeddings or HVG-filtered multi-stage datasets
role: Raw E9.5 count matrix only, independent platform comparison for final fit after source-only dev selection; no E9.5 pseudo-holdout fitting
excluded_fields: All external cross-time morphogenesis vectors and trajectories
Any cross-time HVG/mapping results from tutorial
evidence: Every obs stage is E9.5 (19780 rows)
X equals total layer exactly; nonnegative integer counts
No uns or var pretrained/learned fields
Raw file is loaded before cross-stage gene filtering/HVG/mapping in author tutorial
